### Seeking the Wrong God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/seeking-the-wrong-god
Passage: 2 Kings 1:16
Points:
- Ahaziah foolishly sought guidance and healing from Baal-zebub after suffering a severe injury.
- God sent Elijah to confront the king's messengers because Ahaziah acted as though Israel had no God.
- Rejection of Yahweh in favor of idols brings inescapable divine judgment.
- Believers must take idolatry seriously, turning exclusively to God's Word rather than worldly substitutes.

### Consistent Heroism
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-february-28-2024.html
Passage: 2 Kings 1:2-4
Points:
- Elijah displayed unwavering courage when delivering God's severe message to the king's men.
- God's prophet prioritized obedience over personal safety, ignoring the danger of death.
- Spiritual heroism enables believers to face threatening circumstances with calm resolve.
- God's people today are called to reject shallow theology and speak divine truth without compromise.

### Hairy and Scary
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/hairy-and-scary-one-year-devotions-for-men-october-27.html
Passage: 2 Kings 1:2-4
Points:
- Sudden life crises expose what an individual genuinely believes and relies upon.
- Elijah's trust in Yahweh stands in stark contrast to Ahaziah's desperate appeal to Baal-zebub.
- Loyal faith in the sovereign Creator cannot be compromised with cultural idols.
- Placing trust in anything other than the Lord will collapse when trials strike.

### Bible Pathway - May 1
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-may-1-2012.html
Passage: 2 Kings 1:3
Points:
- Ignoring the Scriptures and seeking guidance outside of God leads a people toward spiritual ruin.
- Elijah boldly spoke the Lord's word to an evil king without fear or compromise.
- God protects, sustains, and strengthens the servants He appoints to carry out His mission.
- Listening to and obeying God's Word builds a secure life on an unshakable foundation.
